caseName: Mobil Alaska Pipeline Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Mobil Alaska Pipeline Co. v. United States Exxon Pipeline Co. v. United States BP Pipelines, Inc. v. United States and ARCO Pipe Line Co. v. United States

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 434 U. S. 964.] Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time for oral argument granted and 15 additional minutes allotted respondents for that purpose. Petitioners also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument. Mr. Justice Stewart and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
